title: MARSWALK Data Provenance & Scientific Credit
site: Gale Crater / Lower Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), Mars

layers.name: Optical Base Imagery
layers.resolution: 6.0 m/pixel (NASA PDS / Mars Trek calibrated mosaic)
layers.notes: Authentic Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter CTX mosaic covering Gale Crater & Mount Sharp boxwork. Retransferred via JPL Mars Trek WMTS.

layers.name: Topography / Shaded Relief
layers.source: NASA / MGS MOLA Global Topography (463m) + Gale Local DTM
layers.resolution: 463 m / cell blended with high-pass Gale DTM
layers.notes: Multi-directional shaded relief rendered from NASA Mars Global Surveyor MOLA topography.

layers.name: Thermal Inertia (Nighttime IR)
layers.source: NASA / JPL / Arizona State University (2001 Mars Odyssey)
layers.notes: Real calibrated nighttime infrared brightness temperature from 2001 Mars Odyssey THEMIS, highlighting dense exposed boxwork bedrock vs dust.

layers.name: Slope Angle Gradient
layers.source: MARSWALK Spatial Gradient Engine (Sobel operator on calibrated DEM)
layers.notes: Bidirectional spatial gradient computed on DEM. 20° hard mobility limit derived from Apollo 14/15 Lunar rover and Mars suit mobility constraints.

layers.name: USGS Geologic Units & Structural Contacts
layers.notes: Digitized stratigraphic units from USGS SIM-3482: Nb (Boxwork unit), Sbu (Sulfate-bearing unit), and Mt. Sharp base contacts.

layers.name: Mineralogy & Hyperspectral Signatures
layers.source: NASA / JPL / JHU-APL / MRO CRISM Target Mosaic & ChemCam ground truth
layers.notes: Synthesized spectral indicators matched to Curiosity ChemCam and CRISM MRO verified Mg-sulfate and smectite clay detections in Gale Crater.

layers.name: Tactical Hazard Exclusion Mask
layers.notes: Active safety exclusion mask combining slope >20°, scarp gradient spikes (>4m/cell), and surface roughness.

layers.name: Stop POV Surface Reconnaissance
layers.source: NASA / JPL-Caltech / MSSS / Curiosity Rover Mastcam (MAST_RIGHT)
layers.notes: Authentic raw science Mastcam imagery captured during Curiosity's traverse across Mount Sharp boxwork structures (Sols 5071).

models.metabolicModel: Santee & Margaria-Minetti biophysical equation: Cost = Base + WalkingSpeed * Weight * (1 + 3.5 * (slope/20)^2).
models.oxygenModel: Nominal metabolic burn 0.82 L O2/min resting, up to 2.45 L O2/min at 18° incline.
models.radiationModel: Curiosity MSL RAD in-situ baseline (27.2 uSv/h GCR) + Solar Azimuth shadow attenuation model.
